scope: Inventory and family-level responsibility review, not complete semantic audit or runtime coverage. Historical source remains included.

aggregate.run_by: separate integration owner, inspected by reviewer

current_review.scope: Family-level disposition, not complete semantic audit or native qualification; baseline inventory and counts above remain unchanged. Serial correction, map candidate and later ratchets are not part of the named integration run.

families.name: entry-and-window
families.adequate_boundary: Qt application ownership, navigation, warmup, camera/vision selection, profile save and video timeline have explicit reviewed owners. Do not split constructor defaults merely to shorten it.
families.remaining_scope: Earlier partial-constructor cleanup remains unsupported; several source-specific activation/effect adapters legitimately stay in the window. Final timer and post-launch abort defects are corrected.
families.unqualified: Packaged fresh/reused desktop launch, real event-loop/native cleanup and platform window behavior.

families.name: domain-and-catalog
families.adequate_boundary: Pure referee metadata, shared economy values, catalog/settings and scenario defaults no longer require runtime factories.
families.remaining_scope: RobotState still contains telemetry, simulation and frontend state; no new demonstrated field-authority defect justifies a broad model rewrite.
families.unqualified: Authoritative field behavior against physical referee/robot sources.

families.name: economy
families.adequate_boundary: Pure selection, explicit reconciliation, immutable intent and named content ports are accepted; label/value dependencies are detached.
families.remaining_scope: Adapters still own reconciliation, animation, scroll, hotspots and transport safety. Student-reload/CS2 host coupling remains, with no new counterexample.
families.unqualified: Physical command acceptance, device gates, native rendering/input timing.

families.name: input-and-overlays
families.adequate_boundary: Pointer/text ownership and characterized modal order are substantive existing boundaries; function length alone does not justify a routing rewrite.
families.remaining_scope: Handlers still receive the window and modal priority crosses services. Any extraction needs explicit press/release consumer ownership and unchanged ordered safety effects.
families.unqualified: Real focus loss, OS input delivery and physical emergency-stop behavior.

families.name: configuration
families.adequate_boundary: Migration/validation, participants/rollback and accepted profile-save state have explicit boundaries.
families.remaining_scope: Storage/registry/UI effect ordering remains adapter-owned; synchronous nested-save behavior is preserved. Crash/multiprocess durability and the combined crosshair editor/parser are separate future scopes.
families.unqualified: Power-loss durability, actual filesystem/platform failure behavior and packaged configuration paths.

families.name: backend-orchestration
families.adequate_boundary: Lifecycle polling, teardown and policy owners already separate resource release, audit integrity and operator success. No generic manager split is proposed.
families.remaining_scope: New bounded counterexample: MQTT malformed port fallback reconverts the invalid value and raises; fractional values can diverge between registry and backend. Mutable-registry admission scope only.
families.unqualified: Real network reconnects, physical arbitration and firmware-confirmed shutdown.

families.name: control-and-qualification
families.adequate_boundary: Explicit pure safety decisions and actual egress rechecks are appropriate; retain distinct readiness/authorization/evidence states.
families.remaining_scope: Cross-layer evidence assembly remains intentional. No new proved defect here; require positive qualified output as well as fail-closed tests for any change.
families.unqualified: Physical remote priority, firmware evidence and device qualification remain prerequisites.

families.name: referee-protocol
families.adequate_boundary: Metadata/factory and annual-policy/value SCCs are removed with real caller/import-blocker evidence. Wire codecs and adapters remain cohesive.
families.remaining_scope: Large field projection retains many literal paths; size alone is not grounds to split annual dispatch or change partial-write semantics.
families.unqualified: Official reference/firmware interoperability and field traffic.

families.name: robot-protocol-and-transport
families.adequate_boundary: Single protocol spec, pure policy and retained native-resource ownership are established boundaries.
families.remaining_scope: Connect/read/write/neutral concurrency remains transport work. No new demonstrated counterexample in this review; preserve queue-versus-confirmation distinction.
families.unqualified: Physical serial traffic, confirmed neutral and permanently blocked driver behavior.

families.name: device-egress
families.adequate_boundary: Angle relay and serial discovery rejected-admission defects have reviewed narrow fixes. Latest-intent mailboxes and retained close are meaningful owners.
families.remaining_scope: New defensive counterexample: DT7/CC constructors whose real Thread.start admits then raises leave a live unsealed owner unavailable to the caller. Not a claim about normal CPython start behavior.
families.unqualified: Physical CC/DT7 ports, handoff and native stalled open/write/close.

families.name: official-transports-and-decoders
families.adequate_boundary: Existing source/native policies and finite owner-admission audits provide bounded seams.
families.remaining_scope: Inherited transport implementations still have specialized lifecycle paths; prior audits are source-bound, not a universal concurrency proof. No new broad rewrite selected.
families.unqualified: Real MQTT/UDP/video/serial peers and native process/pipe/socket faults.

families.name: audit-and-replay
families.adequate_boundary: Logger acceptance/accounting and live/completed/successor ownership fixes passed independent adversarial review. Replay remains publish-free.
families.remaining_scope: No new defect after that correction. Keep accepted/written/pending/dropped/error/drained/intact separate rather than adding one success flag.
families.unqualified: Actual storage faults/durability and sustained field logging throughput.

families.name: vision-and-video-ui
families.adequate_boundary: Camera activation, vision selection/revocation and normal-frame timeline now own specific policies and state.
families.remaining_scope: Video mixin still joins deploy console, spin/lob, control submission and combat feedback. Native configure/start observation points remain deliberate adapters, not falsely claimed extracted.
families.unqualified: Camera/inference drivers, model qualification, native stalls and real aim freshness.

families.name: combat-and-audio
families.adequate_boundary: Event deduplication, explicit confirmed-versus-inferred events and repeated-cue ownership already have evidence.
families.remaining_scope: Decoder/track heuristics and style/sound selection remain combined in some modules; no fresh counterexample makes a size-only split valuable.
families.unqualified: Audio hardware/cache failures, actual playback and physical combat source correspondence.

families.name: core-rendering
families.adequate_boundary: Immutable frame/layer inputs and named paint ports are accepted; command rejection, first registered cause and collection unwind defects are corrected.
families.remaining_scope: Window retains source passes, final present/restore and legacy startup geometry publication. Raw unregistered callback failure can retain a later cleanup reason; do not overstate first-cause coverage.
families.unqualified: Desktop native OpenGL output, driver state, DPI and measured frame cadence/performance.

families.name: specialized-gl
families.adequate_boundary: Renderer-specific resource/context ownership is cohesive; existing finite failure-point tests are useful.
families.remaining_scope: No claim that mocked bind/upload/release checks exhaust driver behavior. Keep resource responsibilities rather than splitting procedural shader/artwork code.
families.unqualified: Native contexts, texture units, upload/recreation and cross-platform driver behavior.

families.name: map-and-status
families.adequate_boundary: Geometry/projection and telemetry-value seams are independently accepted at 184db55; they are outside the named c4d3bcf integration snapshot.
families.remaining_scope: Tactical map still mixes telemetry observations, interactions, caches and paint. The active map lane is substantive; preserve alliance mirroring, TTL, units and command gates.
families.unqualified: Native map presentation, real telemetry rate and physical command coordinates.

families.name: clickgui-layout
families.adequate_boundary: Frame command/registration snapshots are accepted but do not make builders host-independent.
families.remaining_scope: Live window geometry/services, modal policy and interaction registration remain hidden coupling. A future value-input/result seam needs pixel/hit/priority evidence, not helper(window).
families.unqualified: Native font/DPI/animation behavior, real input and packaged assets.

families.name: other-hud-and-presentation
families.adequate_boundary: Style-specific drawing complexity is often cohesive; startup navigation policy has been extracted.
families.remaining_scope: Several remaining mixins read arbitrary window services. Extract only identifiable data/policy ownership with frozen hit/text/status/animation behavior.
families.unqualified: Desktop screenshots, native font metrics, GPU output and performance.

families.name: startup-media
families.adequate_boundary: Existing retained decode ownership and frame snapshots are meaningful.
families.remaining_scope: Discovery/import/package extraction/decode/paint remain mixed; admission/late-generation and close limits deserve bounded review before any larger split.
families.unqualified: Actual media codecs, package files, blocked native decode and thumbnail/resource lifetime.

families.name: animation-and-frame-planning
families.adequate_boundary: Distinct clocks and control/logic/presentation owners are appropriate; preserve ordered adapter effects.
families.remaining_scope: No new proved defect. Local work-time metrics must not be presented as native presentation cadence or end-to-end latency.
families.unqualified: Real scheduling, display cadence, resume behavior and native timing under load.

families.name: assets-locale-and-geometry
families.adequate_boundary: Most loaders/formatters/geometry adapters are cohesive; procedural artwork does not need line-count decomposition.
families.remaining_scope: Language/font-dependent cache invalidation and ordered emergency effects remain acceptance obligations, not new defect claims.
families.unqualified: Platform fonts, CJK bounds, asset packaging and native shortcut delivery.

families.name: paths-and-preflight
families.adequate_boundary: Observational preflight and explicit source/portable roots are sound boundaries; runner root/environment isolation is now real-path tested.
families.remaining_scope: No new source defect selected. Preflight must remain observational and cannot establish packaging or device qualification.
families.unqualified: Installed portable/source deployment permissions, platform paths and actual packaging.

families.name: historical-and-package-facades
families.adequate_boundary: Named lazy package exports preserve import identity while allowing pure owners to import without Qt. Historical facades remain intentionally counted.
families.remaining_scope: Old migration comments can mislead and should be updated with relevant changes; moving retained code earns no reduction credit.
families.unqualified: Legacy execution paths are not current production coverage; platform packaging/import availability remains separate.
